intro: The Assassin is Guildrun's Crit class: burst carries that delete priority targets with critical auto attacks and abilities. Assassins scale Crit, Shards, Poison, Rush, and Stealth — they win the opening pick-off, then clean up. In Demo 0.5.7 they are the highest-ceiling back-line damage in the game, but only if a front line keeps them alive long enough to land the hit. Commit to Assassins when Crit relics show up early and you can protect the back row.
seoDescription: Guildrun Assassin class guide: Crit burst carries that delete priority targets. Best Assassin heroes, relics, positioning, and comp tips.
roleLabel: Crit burst carry — pick-off damage from the back line
strength: Explosive single-target removal: high Crit lets Assassins delete the enemy threat before it acts
weakness: Fragile — no living front line means the Assassins never get their window; hard-countered by AoE and dive

howToPlay.draft: Start one Assassin carry plus a body, not three squishies. Rank B the Assassin who is already getting kills; feed the one your seed supports. Add a wall before a second carry.
howToPlay.shop: Crit and Assassin tags first. Poison, Shards, and Stealth are optional payoffs, not the identity. Buy one defensive item for the front before bosses.
howToPlay.positioning: Assassins sit max range at the back, slightly offset so splash doesn't delete two carries at once. Use Stealth / Rush tools to open a second engage angle.

shopPriorities: Crit and Assassin banners for the burst identity
Assassin-tag damage items on your primary carry
Stealth / Rush tools to create engage angles
One defensive item for whoever holds the front

signatureHeroes.name: Yuuna

signatureHeroes.name: Zuri

faq.question: What is the Assassin class in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Assassins are a Crit-based burst class that removes priority targets with critical auto attacks and abilities, scaling Crit, Shards, Poison, Rush, and Stealth. They are back-line carries that need protection.

faq.question: What are the best Assassin heroes in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Hoyoung (safe-range carry), Yuuna (low-HP finisher), Dragomir (execute/economy), and Zuri (Tank/Assassin hybrid front) are the standout Assassin picks.

faq.question: What relics work with Assassins?
faq.answer: Crit and Assassin banners plus Assassin-tag damage items. Poison, Shards, and Stealth are secondary payoffs — buy them only when the core Crit engine is online.

faq.question: Why do my Assassins keep dying?
faq.answer: Almost always a front-line problem, not a damage problem. Assassins are fragile; add a wall (like Zuri or a Tank) so they survive to land their burst.

tips: If you lose because carries die first, it's a positioning / front-line issue — not a missing damage relic.
Missing-HP Crit items only work when someone is already chunked; they won't carry even fights alone.
